items.title: Dorohedoro
items.reason: A genuinely bizarre world of sorcerers and lizard-headed men, with heavy gore under a distinctive art style.

items.title: Devilman Crybaby
items.reason: Demonic body horror at maximum intensity, with escalating brutality and a singular visual approach.

items.title: Berserk
items.reason: Grim dark-fantasy brutality with demons, real consequence and a world that never softens.

items.title: The Future Diary
items.reason: Twelve diary holders in a survival game whose rules are the puzzle, with heavy gore and constant reversals.

items.title: Tokyo Ghoul
items.reason: Ghoul body horror with real gore and a protagonist forced through irreversible change.

items.title: Hellsing Ultimate
items.reason: Overwhelmingly overpowered vampire action, extremely gory and unapologetic about it.

items.title: Overlord
items.reason: A player trapped as an overpowered undead overlord, with a deep guild-magic system and dark consequence.

items.title: When They Cry
items.reason: A looping rural horror mystery where working out what actually happened is the whole structure.

items.title: Code Geass
items.reason: Strategy and deception at the highest level, with a rule-bound power and constant reversals.

items.title: Re: Zero
items.reason: Death-looping isekai with real brutality, escalating psychological cost and rules that must be worked out.

items.title: Monster
items.reason: A patient, exceptionally dark cat-and-mouse pursuit between a doctor and the monster he saved.

items.title: Death Parade
items.reason: Arbiters judge the dead through games whose hidden rules drive every episode.

items.title: Ergo Proxy
items.reason: Post-apocalyptic sci-fi mystery about what the proxies are, told through a decaying domed city.

items.title: Paprika
items.reason: Dream-invasion sci-fi where reality collapses into spectacle - visually singular throughout.

items.title: Fire Force
items.reason: Pyrokinetic firefighting with a spreading conspiracy, varied abilities and steady action.

items.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
items.reason: An elf mage's long journey after the quest ends, with a deep, quiet magic system and real strangeness.

items.title: Erased
items.reason: A time-loop murder mystery where returning to childhood is the only way to change what happened.

items.title: Mob Psycho 100
items.reason: An overwhelmingly powerful psychic who wants nothing to do with it, in a wildly distinctive visual style.

items.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
items.reason: Reincarnated-as-a-slime progression with an unusually systematic approach to acquiring abilities.

items.title: Serial Experiments Lain
items.reason: A dense, unsettling meditation on identity dissolving into the network - unlike anything else.

items.title: Paranoia Agent
items.reason: An urban legend spreads through a city while the series interrogates its own reality.

items.title: Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song
items.reason: An AI singer sent to prevent a war across a century, with a real time-anomaly premise.

items.title: Terror in Resonance
items.reason: Two teenage bombers set riddles for the police in a cold, precise cat-and-mouse.

items.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero
items.reason: A betrayed shield hero rebuilds through a rule-bound levelling system in a hostile world.

items.title: Black Clover
items.reason: Magicless underdog in a rigidly systematised magic world, with relentless battle escalation.

items.title: Baccano!
items.reason: Immortals, gangsters and a runaway train, told out of order until the pieces snap together.

items.title: Perfect Blue
items.reason: An idol's identity fractures under stalking and delusion - a genuinely disturbing psychological spiral.
